description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling schedule-related API endpoints in a gym management system. It includes data models, role validation, and a main endpoint to retrieve a user's combined schedule, aggregating workouts, trainer bookings, and class sessions with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: ScheduleItemOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a normalized schedule item with type, id, start/end times, title, and optional status.

methods.name: _validate_role_or_raise
methods.description: Checks if the user role is authorized ('member', 'trainer', 'admin') and raises HTTP 403 if not.

methods.name: _paginate
methods.description: Paginates a list of items based on page number and page size, returning the subset and total count.

methods.name: get_schedule
methods.description: Main API endpoint that retrieves a combined, filtered, and paginated list of schedule items (workouts, trainer bookings, classes) for the authenticated user.
